_help: W5 overlay art (breakable block Z, spike trap X, solid decoration Y) + wall decoration (t = torch, [ = left-wall torch, ] = right-wall torch, v = shield; code 4-7, drawn on wall tiles, no collision). mem/ovtile.mem is GENERATED from this file.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_overlay_mem.py

pics 0..2 = Z / X / Y, 3-6 = torch flame frames, 7 / 8 = side torches, 9 = shield. file = 16x16 picture, scale 2 -> 32x32. cut = exact [r,g,b] colours that become see-through. plate = [r,g,b] rectangle under the picture.
Missing / invalid file -> a procedural placeholder (printed warning), the game still builds. Keys starting with _ are comments.
